title: 苹果新芯片：核心数翻倍？，官方数据却不同
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Apple has announced upgraded Mac Mini and Mac Studio desktop computers with the new machines available to pre-order and installs on September 22nd. The upgrade follows a surge in demand for
segments.zh: 苹果发布了升级版Mac Mini和Mac Studio台式电脑，新机型已开放预购，9月22日发货。此次升级前，市场对现有Mac Mini的需求激增，

segments.en: the current Mac Mini which has become a popular tool for running AI applications locally.
segments.zh: 该机型已成为本地运行AI应用的热门工具。

segments.en: The Universe Mark German's here with the details. You'd reported this was coming and now we have it.
segments.zh: Universe Mark German在此为您带来详情。您之前报道过这一消息，现在终于发布了。

segments.en: It's an important upgrade, probably the most significant upgrade in this line for two years.
segments.zh: 这是一次重要升级，可能是该产品线两年来最重大的升级。

segments.en: What are the main specs that we need to know? Yeah, people have been waiting for these new Mac Mini's and Mac Studios for quite some time.
segments.zh: 我们需要了解哪些主要规格？是的，人们期待新款Mac Mini和Mac Studio已经有一段时间了。

segments.en: The inventory situation for both of these machines has been inexplicable because of the memory shortage, because of the silicon shortage combined with the demand for these machines the
segments.zh: 这两款机器的库存状况一直紧张，原因是内存短缺、芯片短缺，加上需求旺盛，

segments.en: people are buying really in hot numbers to do on-device AI processing on their desks.
segments.zh: 人们大量购买，以便在桌面上进行设备端AI处理。

segments.en: The big news here is the M6 chip is being introduced for the first time. This is coming to the Mac Mini. The Mac Mini also be able to get the M5 Pro chip from the MacBook Pros rolled out in March.
segments.zh: 重大消息是M6芯片首次亮相，将搭载于Mac Mini。Mac Mini还可选配3月发布的MacBook Pro中的M5 Pro芯片。

segments.en: The Mac Studio has the M5 Mac chip from the MacBook Pros in March but also for the first time Apple is introducing a new M5 Ultra chip with up to 80 CPU cores as well as half a terabyte of memory
segments.zh: Mac Studio搭载了3月MacBook Pro中的M5芯片，但苹果还首次推出了全新的M5 Ultra芯片，最多80个CPU核心，以及高达半TB的内存容量。

segments.en: capacity. So these are pretty big upgrades but they're also expensive. The Mac Studio, the Ultra version,
segments.zh: 这些升级相当大，但价格也不菲。Mac Studio Ultra版，

segments.en: that starts at around $5500 and the Mac Mini, the price has gone up from it used to be $600. The
segments.zh: 起售价约5500美元，Mac Mini价格从600美元上调。
